role: weapons officer of the warship GVTS, choosing targets and firing the forward chain gun with the weapons console keys
mission: lock the enemy ship and keep hitting it with the chain gun until it is destroyed

target.instructions: Which targeting key do you press now?

options.next: lock the next contact the filters allow (only contacts scanned at least BASIC); the console then marks the locked contact (LOCKED). With no lock the pilot cannot follow the target. Choose this when the console says no weapons lock and lists a ship
options.clear: drop the current lock: the pilot loses the target
options.none: press none: keep the current lock, or keep having none. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock

fireChainGun:0.instructions: Which do you do with the chain gun trigger now?

options.fire: fire for half a second straight ahead along the ship's nose; shells explode at the locked target's distance, up to 8000 m, in a blast about 100 m wide each side. A shell hits when the LOCKED contact is within 100 m of the nose's line, so the closer the target the more degrees off the nose still hit: under 600 m up to 8�, under 1.5 km up to 4�, farther only 2�. Choose this when the radar lists the LOCKED contact under 8 km away and that close to the nose
options.hold_fire: do not fire. Choose this when there is no lock, when the LOCKED contact is further off the nose than its distance allows (under 600 m: 8�, under 1.5 km: 4�, farther: 2�), or when the radar does not list the LOCKED contact at all (you cannot see where it is, so shells would be wasted)

loadChainGun:0.instructions: Which do you do with the chain gun loading switch now?

options.on: keep the gun loading rounds, so it can fire
options.off: stop loading: the gun cannot fire once its round is spent

changeGunAmmo:0.instructions: Which do you do with the gun ammunition key now?

options.press: switch the gun to the next shell type ; high-explosive shells are the ones that kill

targetEnemyOnly.instructions: Which way do you set the enemies-only targeting filter?

options.on: the targeting keys only lock enemy contacts
options.off: the targeting keys also lock friends and neutrals

targetShipsOnly.instructions: Which way do you set the ships-only targeting filter?

options.on: the targeting keys only lock ships
options.off: the targeting keys also lock other objects

targetShortRangeOnly.instructions: Which way do you set the short-range targeting filter?

options.on: the targeting keys only lock contacts close to the ship
options.off: the targeting keys lock contacts at any range
